site_name: Iron Mountain AZP-1 (formerly i/o Data Centers Phoenix ONE), 615 N 48th St, Phoenix, AZ 85008
year_evidence_quote: the 180,000 square foot first phase of its Phoenix ONE data center, which opened in June
year_site_match: The Data Center Knowledge page names the facility Phoenix ONE and describes it as a 538,000 square foot building, but gives no street address. The address tie comes from the Rose Law Group Reporter article (May 3, 2013), which says IO Phoenix One LLC bought the 538,000-square-foot data center building at 615 N. 48th Street, Phoenix, and that IO Data Centers "has occupied the Phoenix property since June 2009." Iron Mountain's AZP-1 page lists 615 N 48th Street, Phoenix, AZ 85008.
verification: Claimed year 2009 supported. Two opened pages agree on June 2009: the trade-press page (byline date October 22, 2009) says the first phase opened in June, and the 2013 Rose Law Group Reporter article gives the address and says IO has occupied the property since June 2009. The same 538,000 sq ft building size appears on both, which is what links the name Phoenix ONE to 615 N. 48th Street. The opening year on the cited page is taken from its byline date, since the text says only "in June"; the page-reading tool flagged the byline date as unconfirmed because sidebar items carry 2026 dates, but the Rose Law article independently states June 2009. Iron Mountain's own AZP-1 page confirms the address and gives no date. Rose Law's wording is "occupied," not "opened," so I cited the trade-press page as the opening statement.

lead.notes: A May 3, 2013 article (Rose Law Group Reporter) names the IO data center at 615 N. 48th Street and says IO has occupied it since June 2009.
